v: Calgary's public data is spread across many places. Calgary Insight brings it together in one.
A free, non-partisan website, made by a Calgarian, at calgary insight dot c a.
It pulls City data every day: three-one-one requests, traffic incidents, permits and more, for the whole city or any of its fourteen wards.
Put any ward next to the other thirteen.
See the twenty twenty-six City budget, where the money comes from, and property tax by ward.
See how close homes are to everyday amenities, and what condition the water mains and roads are in.
Election data, a business map, Canada's safest cities, daily Calgary news, and a guide for visitors.
Every figure shows its formula and its source, so anyone can check the work.
Two A I tools go further. Data Genie answers any question about the data. Data Scientist writes full analysis reports.
Both are behind a passcode. To get one, send a request to the developer, at hello at calgary insight dot c a.

Any report can go through a three-way audit. Chinook, the auditor, re-runs every figure. Bow, the reviewer, rules on each finding and writes the corrected report. Rundle, the final checker, confirms every finding was dealt with.
Calgary's open data, explained for everyone. Calgary Insight, by Hassan Ali.
